category: inference gateway, no allowance of its own

free_tier.stated: no inference allowance of its own: the core features (dashboard analytics, caching, rate limiting) are free on all plans, while inference is billed by the upstream provider on the caller's own key or through Unified Billing credits bought with a payment method
free_tier.notes: a 5% fee applies to credits bought through Unified Billing; provider token rates pass through at no markup

interface_detail: provider-native endpoints that forward to the provider, with caching, rate limiting and analytics in between
tooling: any provider SDK pointed at the gateway base URL; credentials resolve in the order request key, stored key (BYOK), Unified Billing
chaining: pair with a provider that has its own free key, such as inference/google-gemini-api or inference/cloudflare-workers-ai, to add caching and rate limiting at no charge

limits.value: Unified Billing needs credits bought with a payment method; without them the caller supplies a provider key
100,000 logs total across all gateways on Workers Free (Legacy Logs)

binding_note: the gate is the payment method for credits, not a quota; the gateway adds no free tokens

identity_cost.detail: the Cloudflare account sign-up form takes an email address and a password; 'all it takes is a Cloudflare account' for the free core features; buying Unified Billing credits needs a payment method

reliability_note: the account's credit balance can go negative, and Cloudflare then charges the payment method on file for the outstanding amount
confidence_note: the free core features and the credit requirement are quoted from the vendor pages; no request was made

evidence.quote: AI Gateway's core features available today are offered for free, and all it takes is a Cloudflare account and one line of code to [get started](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/get-started/). Core features include: dashboard analytics, caching, and rate limiting.
evidence.proved: the gateway's core features are free and need a Cloudflare account

evidence.quote: | Workers Free | 100,000 logs total across all gateways |
evidence.proved: Workers Free keeps 100,000 logs total across all gateways in Legacy Logs

evidence.quote: Unified Billing allows users to call Workers AI and connect to various AI providers (such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google AI Studio) and receive a single Cloudflare bill.
evidence.proved: Unified Billing covers Workers AI and third-party providers on one Cloudflare bill

evidence.quote: When a request reaches AI Gateway, credentials are resolved in this order:
evidence.proved: credentials resolve in a fixed order: request key, stored key, then Unified Billing

evidence.quote: In rare instances, your credit balance may go negative. If this happens, Cloudflare will charge the payment method on file for the outstanding amount.
evidence.proved: a negative credit balance is charged to the payment method on file

evidence.quote: To use Unified Billing, you must purchase and load credits into your Cloudflare account in the Cloudflare dashboard, which you can then spend with AI Gateway.
If your account does not have an available payment method, AI Gateway will prompt you to add a payment method to purchase credits.
evidence.proved: buying credits needs a payment method on the account

evidence.quote: A 5% fee is applied to all credits purchased through Unified Billing.
evidence.proved: a 5% fee applies to purchased credits
the Cloudflare account sign-up form takes an email address and a password

notes: The Workers AI free allocation is a separate offer recorded at inference/cloudflare-workers-ai; the gateway can front it.
